item.title: EplayerX 1.2.24
item.description:
## 更新内容
- 网盘媒体库卡片现可显示已识别的电影和剧集数量，并随媒体库更新。 - 修复搜索结果刷新时可能发生的崩溃，提升搜索和历史记录操作的稳定性。 - 改善部分 Emby 兼容服务器的下载请求兼容性。 - 优化媒体封面加载时的鉴权信息匹配，减少重复处理。
需要 macOS 12.0 或更高版本，请按 Mac 芯片选择 Apple Silicon 或 Intel 安装包。
## What’s New
- Cloud drive library cards now show recognized movie and series counts and refresh as the library changes. - Fixed a potential crash when search results refresh, improving search and history stability. - Improved download request compatibility with certain Emby-compatible servers. - Reduced repeated processing when matching authentication headers for artwork requests.
Requires macOS 12.0 or later. Choose the Apple Silicon or Intel download for your Mac.
